title: Expert Systems and Rule-Based AI
overview: Learn how knowledge bases of if-then rules and an inference engine capture expert decision making.
objectives: Describe the knowledge base and inference engine
Identify strengths and limits of rule-based systems

method.title: Components
method.body: An expert system separates domain knowledge (rules and facts) from a general inference engine.

method.title: Forward chaining
method.body: Starts from known facts and fires rules until new conclusions stop appearing.

method.title: Backward chaining
method.body: Starts from a goal and works back to find facts that would support it.

method.title: Limits
method.body: Rule bases are costly to build and maintain, are brittle outside their domain, and handle uncertainty poorly without extensions.
